resolved_conflicts.explanation: Global News puts the lookout northwest of Hinton; the Edmonton Journal says north. Both agree on about 25 km. The story reports both.
The register's 2011 date is for the tower now on the site. News from before 2006 describes a watch tower with an onsite cabin at the same lookout, so 2011 is not the date of the first tower there.

notes_for_editor: Brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source read; recorded as restricted, as in ca-ab-baseline-2. The 2011 date comes from the register's YEAR_CONSTRUCTED field, read through the layer's query endpoint; the layer's HTML metadata does not show it, and the brief's source_pages list only metadata. The 'earlier tower' point is my inference from the 2011 register date and 2006 news. The Edmonton Journal title is reconstructed from its URL slug. The spotter is not named in the story and her personal details are left out. Agency is omitted: the brief's 'Alberta Wildfire' is not quoted in any source read, and the news names the 2006 ministry. Mapcarta places the site in Yellowhead County, but the brief has no local_unit, so the story says Alberta only. Fact-check 2026-10-20: 'each summer' changed to the cited April-to-September wording; the 2011 'later structure' sentence softened to a conditional because it rests on the register date being right.
